title: How soon after an Autism diagnosis can we start Speech Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network?
metaTitle: Starting Speech Therapy Post Autism Diagnosis | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand how you can promptly start Speech Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network following an Autism diagnosis. Progress is possible at any age.
html: You can initiate Speech Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network as soon as you feel comfortable after receiving an Autism diagnosis. We strongly advocate for early intervention, but we equally believe in progress at any age. With the individualized therapy plan our therapists will formulate for your child, they can start on their journey of improvement right away.
